summary.tagline: Explore the wild Tin Coast and iconic engine houses of the Cornish Mining World Heritage Site.
summary.best_season: Spring and summer offer the most reliable walking conditions on cliffside tracks.

travel.headline: Historic Mining Sites and Coastal Access
travel.reservation: Access to Botallack is generally open for walking, though specific guided events or internal building access may require checking National Trust updates. Parking is available near the Count House, though specific fees or membership requirements should be verified on-site as policies are subject to change.

days.title: The Tin Coast Heritage
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM from St Ives or Penzance

stops.name: Botallack
stops.detail: Explore the iconic engine houses clinging to the cliff face and follow the one-mile mining walk to discover the site's industrial heritage.

days.driving: Allow 20-40 minutes; conditions vary on narrow B-roads and village tracks.
days.note: The track to the car park passes the Manor; drive slowly through the village transition.

intel.title: Navigating the Track
intel.text: The route turns into a track near Botallack Manor leading to the car park. Ensure your vehicle is suitable for unpaved track segments past the village bend.

intel.title: Coastal Walking
intel.text: The South West Coast Path runs directly past the Count House. Allow extra time if connecting to longer regional segments along the Tin Coast.

intel.title: Local Services
intel.text: Evidence does not specify fuel or charging at the mine site. Verify supplies in Penzance or St Just before turning onto the B3306.

intel.title: Connectivity Status
intel.text: Mobile signal strength is not documented in available sources for this cliffside location. Download heritage maps before leaving the main village areas.

intel.title: Site Parking
intel.text: A car park is located just past the Count House and Workshop. Spaces may be limited during peak summer walking hours.

plan.arrival: Pick up a rental in Penzance, stock up on essentials, and follow the B3306 toward the village of Botallack.
plan.vehicle: Standard cars are suitable for the B3306, though the final track to the car park requires cautious driving.
plan.goldenHour: Engine houses at Botallack offer dramatic silhouettes against the Atlantic sunset, subject to seasonal weather.
